The '''Imperial throne room''' located in the [[Emperor's Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] was the primary [[Emperor's throne room|command room]] for the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his [[Dark Empire]].
